_comment: Optional per-repo Loobster config — copy to .claude/loobster.json. `subagents` sets a preferred model per delegation role; every phase command reads it before spawning an Agent. Values are whatever your runtime's Agent tool accepts as a model override (Claude Code: 'sonnet' | 'opus' | 'haiku' | a full model id such as 'claude-opus-4-8'). Omit a role (or the whole file) to inherit the session model. Tips: make `verify` a DIFFERENT model than `act` — cross-model verification catches self-consistent mistakes a same-model judge repeats; and give `resolver` (the clean-context agent that retries a capped-out fix loop with a different approach before any human escalation) your strongest model — it only runs when the act model is already stuck.
